The '''Mission to Alderaan''' was a mission carried out by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] mercenary [[Rianna Saren]] and her droid companion
[[Z-58-0|Zeeo]]. After completing her mission on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Rianna agreed to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] investigate strange activity on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] had hijacked a research vessel.

==Mission==
{{Quote|I think I'm going to be sick.|[[Rianna Saren]] after discovering the true purpose of the vessel|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
With the help of [[Z-58-0|Zeeo]], [[Rianna Saren|Rianna]] infiltrated the ship and sliced the main computer. She then discovered that the vessel was used to test new drugs on scientists. Once there, she was confronted by several [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], but managed to defeat them with the help of Zeeo. Rianna planted charges in the nearby warehouse and the laboratory and then watched as [[Slak Sagar]], who was in charge of the vessel, interacted with [[Zarien Kheev]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] slaver, who once owned Rianna. Kheev ordered Slak to leave no witnesses and Sagar said that he will deliver the last shipment to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. However, Rianna planted the explosive on the shipment in the docking bay and escaped the vessel. She was then attacked by Sagar, but managed to defeat him. Leia Organa contacted a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and informed her that those drugs were used to increase the slave production of [[Mirkanite/Legends|mirkanite]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Hoping to find Kheev there and finally get her revenge, Rianna asked [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] to send her there instead of [[Kyle Katarn]].
